How does it work:

4) You confirm the operation!

Other than the ease of use, the main highlights of DeDuplicate and its unique selling points are:

• it’s not resource-hungry: it doesn’t need to download the files to identify duplicates. Instead, it requests metadata about them from the cloud providers, using the APIs that they make available. Of course, it depends upon the network connection.
